position_accounting: Count all model-visible text/media/latent positions, padding actually computed, every epoch, replay, extra sensing/prefill and inner/outer backbone execution. A position visited twice is charged twice. Conservatively price frozen-backbone inner executions as a full checkpointed training execution; do not apply another inner-step multiplier to those same positions.

includes: all original backbone parameters including tied embedding/head counted once
plastic knowledge experts and their initialization/read paths
recurrent core, grounding/appraisal heads and lexical machinery
bounded UAP interface; device-specific experts and external teacher models are separate workloads

workload.physical_microbatch: Chosen only after memory qualification; accumulation holds the effective position budget fixed.

elapsed_overhead_includes: F1 modality warmup allowance outside the main full-scope position total; F0 hardware qualification is a separate fixed allowance
held-out generation, sensory interventions and retention checks
checkpoint I/O, normal data stalls and a bounded recovery allowance
campaign_interpretation: One candidate schedule plus two full-schedule-equivalent development/replication reserves. Eight online factorial arms are not eight fresh full-backbone training schedules. This is a finite research reserve, not a confidence interval or a guarantee of convergence.
